name: Patience (Sabr)

definition_by_age.4: Waiting calmly, even when it's hard.
definition_by_age.6: Sabr means staying calm and not giving up when something is difficult or takes time.
definition_by_age.8: Sabr is patience through hardship, waiting, and self-control, trusting that Allah rewards those who stay steady.

learning_objective: Children can wait their turn calmly and name it as sabr.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_002). Waiting->Reframe->Acceptance is the pattern literally built for patience — was defaulted to unrelated pattern_002.

qv_007.reasoning: Directly commands sabr by name and promises Allah's companionship to the patient — the foundational patience verse.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: A boring necessary appointment fits natural-consequence-of-waiting learning.
Losing patience in a line, then correcting, fits mistake-reflection too.
